name: @pipeworx/mcp-birdeye

tools.name: birdeye_token_overview
tools.description: Token overview — price, liquidity, volume for token X. Returns market cap, 24h price change, and holder count for a Solana (or multichain) token by contract address. Example: birdeye_token_overview({ address: "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112", chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Token contract/mint address, e.g. "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112" (wrapped SOL) on Solana, or a 0x address on an EVM chain.

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana". Examples: "solana", "ethereum", "base", "bsc", "polygon".

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

tools.name: birdeye_token_holders
tools.description: Top holders of token X. Returns the largest wallet holders of a token (owner address, token amount, and share of supply) by contract address. Example: birdeye_token_holders({ address: "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112", limit: 20, chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

limit.description: Number of top holders to return (1–50, default 50).

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana".

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

tools.name: birdeye_token_trades
tools.description: Recent DEX trades for token X. Returns the latest on-chain swap transactions for a token (side, amounts, price, trader, timestamp) by contract address. Example: birdeye_token_trades({ address: "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112", limit: 20, chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

limit.description: Number of recent trades to return (1–50, default 50).

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana".

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

tools.name: birdeye_gainers_losers
tools.description: Top trader gainers/losers. Returns the ranked list of wallets by realized/unrealized PnL over a time window (yesterday/today/1W/30d/90d). Example: birdeye_gainers_losers({ type: "1W", sort_by: "PnL", chain: "solana", _apiKey: "your-key" })

type.description: Time window for PnL ranking: "yesterday", "today", "1W", "30d", or "90d". Defaults to "1W".

limit.description: Number of traders to return (1–50, default 20).

chain.description: Blockchain to query (sent as the x-chain header). Defaults to "solana".

_apiKey.description: Birdeye API key (get one at birdeye.so; limited free tier).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-birdeye forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the birdeye pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
